"GAME: PUBG PC-LEVEL MASSIVE BATTLE ROYALE

Create a realistic, high-quality 3D open-world Battle Royale PC game inspired by PUBG PC.

MAP

- Massive 16 × 16 km seamless open-world map.
- Multiple large cities, villages, military bases, airports, ports, forests, mountains, deserts and rivers.
- Hundreds of buildings, enterable interiors, highways, bridges and hidden bunkers.
- Realistic terrain, detailed environments and long-distance visibility.
- No loading screens while exploring.

GAMEPLAY

- 100-player Battle Royale with AI bots.
- Solo, Duo and Squad modes.
- Aircraft insertion and parachuting.
- Looting, inventory and weapon attachments.
- Shrinking blue zone and supply drops.
- Last survivor wins.

COMBAT

- Realistic FPS and TPS camera.
- Assault rifles, snipers, SMGs, shotguns and pistols.
- Realistic recoil, bullet physics, aiming and reloading.
- Smooth character animations and responsive controls.

VEHICLES

Cars, jeeps, motorcycles, trucks, boats and helicopters.

GRAPHICS

- PUBG PC-level realistic graphics.
- High-quality PBR materials, lighting, shadows and reflections.
- Realistic weather, forests, water and day/night cycle.
- Detailed weapons, characters and environments.

OPTIMIZATION

- Keep game size as small as possible.
- Use world streaming, LOD, occlusion culling and compressed assets.
- Load only nearby environment assets.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies and duplicate assets.
- Support Low, Medium, High and Ultra graphics.
- Ensure stable FPS and smooth gameplay.

FINAL REQUIREMENT

Create a complete, playable, massive open-world Battle Royale PC game with realistic graphics, intelligent enemies, vehicles and immersive combat. Prioritize quality, optimization and working gameplay over unnecessary features.
"
